title: clematis dioica subsp. acapulcensis
intro: Clematis dioica subsp. acapulcensis, commonly known as the Mexican virgin's bower, is a species of flowering plant in the clematis genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Clematis dioica subsp. acapulcensis include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, with its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is known to contain flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides that contribute to its medicinal effects.
